summary.zh: 一批滚动与界面体验修复：所有页面的滚动位置在进出详情页后不再丢失，工作流筛选不再闪烁，仓库详情各 tab 数据预加载，切换即现。
summary.en: Scroll and navigation polish: scroll positions survive detail-page round trips on every screen, workflow filter chips no longer flash, and repo detail tabs are prefetched so switching renders instantly.

items.zh: 修复：全 App 滚动位置丢失——从列表/详情页进出后返回，列表、概览 tab、issue/PR 详情、markdown 文件浏览等都恢复到原位置
items.en: Scroll positions are now preserved across navigate-away-and-back on every screen: lists, overview tab, issue/PR details, markdown file viewer

items.zh: 修复：markdown/图片等异步内容长高导致恢复位置偏移，恢复现在跟随内容增长持续贴位，用户一拖动立即交还控制权
items.en: Restore now tracks late-loading content (markdown/images) and re-pins until the position sticks; any user drag immediately cancels the pin

items.zh: 修复：工作流运行列表每次刷新都强制跳回顶部，从运行详情返回不再回顶；新构建出现或切换筛选时才回到最新
items.en: Workflow run list no longer force-scrolls to top on return from a run detail; it only jumps for genuinely new runs or filter changes

items.zh: 修复：工作流筛选 chips 行闪烁——从详情页返回时分支行先消失再弹出，现在保持稳定两行
items.en: Workflow filter chip rows no longer flash between one and two rows when returning from a detail page

items.zh: 优化：仓库详情各数据 tab（Issues/PRs/Releases/工作流）进入后自动预加载，切换 tab 即时呈现不再转骨架
items.en: Repo detail tabs (Issues/PRs/Releases/Workflows) are prefetched on entry, so tab switches render instantly instead of skeletons

items.zh: 界面：发现页信息源「更改」按钮紧跟来源名后；仓库列表项去掉多余序号
items.en: Discover page: the source switch now sits right after the source name; repo list items drop the redundant rank numbers
